verdict.rationale: TeamViewer documents its own Web API, and its pricing page lists API access alongside audit logs, so a first-party programmatic surface exists. Nothing in the pack shows how much of the UI's functionality that API covers, and probes for a machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt all returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of API parity with UI features (sessions, device management, monitoring, AI features), endpoint-level documentation in the pack, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
